nodes.name: Is input valid?
nodes.notes: Routes valid requests to Gemini and invalid ones to the error response.

nodes.name: Reject invalid input
nodes.notes: Returns HTTP 400 with the list of validation errors to Angular.

nodes.name: Parse and check Gemini output
nodes.notes: Parses the JSON and checks recipe count, ingredient usage (70 percent), extra ingredients (max 3) and required fields.

nodes.name: Prepare database rows
nodes.notes: Maps each recipe to a row of the recipes table and adds one shared batch id.

nodes.name: Save recipes
nodes.notes: Saves the 3 recipes in the Supabase table recipes.

values.content:
=You are a cooking assistant. Create exactly 3 different recipes as JSON.

Available ingredients (user input): {{ JSON.stringify($('Validate input').first().json.data.ingredients) }}
Portions: {{ $('Validate input').first().json.data.portions }}
Cooking helpers: {{ $('Validate input').first().json.data.helpers }}
Time category: {{ $('Validate input').first().json.data.time }} (quick = up to 20 min, medium = 20 to 45 min, complex = over 45 min)
Cuisine: {{ $('Validate input').first().json.data.cuisine }}
Diet: {{ $('Validate input').first().json.data.diet }} (none = no restriction)
Language of all texts: {{ $('Validate input').first().json.data.language }}

Rules:
- Each recipe uses at least 70 percent of the available ingredients.
- Each recipe has at most 3 extra ingredients (basic ones only), listed in extra_ingredients.
- The 3 recipes differ in preparation method or flavor.
- Respect the diet strictly. Do not use ingredients that violate it.
- Never use more of an available ingredient than the user listed. Scale only extra ingredients to the portions.
- Do not list salt, pepper or water as extra ingredients.
- Units must be one of: piece, ml, gram.
- Steps are chronological and beginner friendly. Use waiting times for other steps. Assign each step to a helper number from 1 to {{ $('Validate input').first().json.data.helpers }}. Steps that run at the same time list the other step orders in parallel_with.
- Every helper gets at least one step, and the final steps may be shared.
- The cooking time matches the time category.
- Nutrition in kcal, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, per portion and for the whole recipe.
- Titles are short and natural.

Return only JSON in this form, no text around it:
{"recipes":[{"title":"","cooking_time_min":0,"used_ingredients":[{"name":"","amount":0,"unit":""}],"extra_ingredients":[{"name":"","amount":0,"unit":""}],"steps":[{"order":1,"title":"","text":"","helper":1,"parallel_with":[]}],"nutrition":{"per_portion":{"kcal":0,"protein_g":0,"carbs_g":0,"fat_g":0},"total":{"kcal":0,"protein_g":0,"carbs_g":0,"fat_g":0}}}]}

nodes.name: Generate 3 recipes with Gemini
nodes.notes: Asks Gemini for 3 different recipes as JSON, based on ingredients and preferences. Retries on temporary errors.

nodes.name: Return batch id
nodes.notes: Sends the batch id to Angular, which loads the recipes from Supabase.

nodes.name: Extract client IP
nodes.notes: Reads the client IP from proxy headers (IPv4 and IPv6) and validates the format.

nodes.name: Is quota available?
nodes.notes: Routes requests with free quota to Gemini and all others to the 429 response.

nodes.name: Reject quota exceeded
nodes.notes: Returns HTTP 429 so Angular can show a meaningful quota message.

nodes.name: Consume quota
nodes.notes: Checks and increases the daily quota per IP (3) and system wide (12) in one atomic step.
